kiki.tagline: Messages from my phone, as a bubble on the TV
kiki.about: I type on my phone, wherever I am, and a bubble pops up on the Android TV, on top of Netflix or any other app. Texts, photo stickers, polls answered with the remote and giant emojis. Everything is end-to-end encrypted (AES-256-GCM): the relay server only ever sees unreadable data.

cockpit.tagline: Savings, job applications and workouts in one place
cockpit.about: A personal dashboard you can install on your phone: savings forecast and budget, job applications with follow-up reminders, workouts with weights and progress. Data stays in the browser, with optional sync.

Riad.tagline: Online booking for a Moroccan riad
Riad.about: A full application for a riad guesthouse: photo gallery, online booking with e-mail confirmation, customer area, admin dashboard and a chatbot that answers questions about the rooms.

tourmoroccowithmoh.tagline: The website of a private tour guide in Morocco
tourmoroccowithmoh.about: A multilingual showcase site (English, French, Spanish) for a tour guide: tours, one page per city (Marrakech, Fes, Chefchaouen, Merzouga…), a travel-tips blog, FAQ and careful SEO.

website-Tour.tagline: The same tour site, rebuilt with Next.js
website-Tour.about: A modern version of the Morocco tours site, built with the help of AI: generated destination pages, contact form, WhatsApp button, structured data and sitemap.

gift-whisper.tagline: Five very specific gift ideas, by AI
gift-whisper.about: Describe the person and the app suggests five highly targeted gift ideas using Llama 3.3. The API key stays secret on the server, behind a serverless function.

mon-portfolio.title: Neon portfolio
mon-portfolio.tagline: A portfolio you explore like a game
mon-portfolio.about: My previous cyberpunk-style portfolio: you walk around a canvas world with an avatar (WASD / arrow keys), with neon effects, frosted glass and built-in mini-games.

finance.tagline: Daily market brief and targeted job offers
finance.about: A personal page with two sections: the market brief and the monthly order computed for a French PEA account, and the best Java job offers in a city with a recruiter contact, a LinkedIn message and a tailored CV for each offer.

ios-gym-tracker.tagline: Workout tracking on iPhone, no server
ios-gym-tracker.about: A minimal iPhone app to log workouts (sets, reps, weights), track progress and plan Push / Pull / Legs splits, with today's session suggested automatically.

shadow-cloneJutsu-naruto.tagline: Naruto's shadow clone technique, in front of the webcam
shadow-cloneJutsu-naruto.about: Make Naruto's hand sign in front of the webcam and clones appear on screen. Hand tracking runs live in the browser.

analyse-PDF-technique-UML-chatbot.title: Momo AI · PDF analysis
analyse-PDF-technique-UML-chatbot.about: An app that reads several technical PDFs, extracts the key concepts, compares them (graphs, word clouds, statistics) and lets you ask them questions with Mistral.

Planification-avec-Contraintes-nerg-tiqu.title: Energy-aware scheduling
Planification-avec-Contraintes-nerg-tiqu.tagline: Scheduling a factory while using as little energy as possible
Planification-avec-Contraintes-nerg-tiqu.about: Models a workshop where each operation can run on several machines that can be switched on or off. The algorithms look for a schedule that balances total duration and energy use, tested on about a hundred instances.

Recherche-Op-Data-abalytics.title: Scheduling · data
Recherche-Op-Data-abalytics.tagline: The same factory problem, analysis side
Recherche-Op-Data-abalytics.about: A second version of the energy-constrained job scheduling lab, exporting schedules to CSV and plotting the results.

HDI-analytics.title: HDI analysis
HDI-analytics.tagline: What drives the Human Development Index
HDI-analytics.about: A statistical study of the world's countries: how the HDI relates to life expectancy, income per person or region, with charts and statistical tests.

tomcat-and-nats-Communication.title: NATS · date and time
tomcat-and-nats-Communication.about: A script that listens on a NATS subject and replies on request with the date and time as JSON, so a Tomcat server can talk to other services.

Google-Authentication-oAuth2.0-with-Spri.title: Recipe sharing
Google-Authentication-oAuth2.0-with-Spri.about: A platform to publish your recipes, explore other people's, comment on them and rate them. Sign in with your Google account via OAuth2.

FestiCar.about: A REST API to book a carpool ride to a festival: festivals, towns, stops, packs and cart, e-mail notifications and PDF tickets. Team project during my MIAGE master's degree.

Miahoot-Spring.about: The back end of a live quiz game in the style of Kahoot: teachers, quizzes, questions, answers and participants, exposed as a REST API. Team project during my MIAGE bachelor's degree.

Miahoot-Angular-Firebase.about: The interface of the live quiz: sign-in, quiz creation by the teacher and real-time participation for players.

Author-application-SpringBoot.title: Library API
Author-application-SpringBoot.tagline: Authors, books and loans over REST
Author-application-SpringBoot.about: An API that manages a library: create, search, update and delete authors and books, tested with Postman. MIAGE bachelor's lab.

GContacts-WS-Client-Soap.tagline: Contact management over a SOAP web service
GContacts-WS-Client-Soap.about: A SOAP web service for managing contacts backed by a MySQL database, and its web client built with servlets and JSP.

Geometric-Shapes-Editor.title: Shapes editor
Geometric-Shapes-Editor.about: A drawing app to create, move and delete geometric shapes, with undo / redo (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y) and JSON or XML export. Built around the Observer, Visitor and Command patterns.

Light-UP-akari-.about: The rules of the Akari puzzle are turned into a logical formula, then solved by a SAT solver we wrote ourselves with the DPLL algorithm. An interface lets you play and see the solution.

Tux-Game.tagline: A penguin collecting the letters of a word
Tux-Game.about: A game where Tux the penguin must collect the letters of a word in order in under 30 seconds. Words, profiles and games are stored as XML.

Snake-Game.tagline: The game from my childhood, rebuilt
Snake-Game.about: Classic Snake: the snake grows with every apple, and the game ends at the first wall or the first bite.

tiktaktoe-Java.about: A Java tic-tac-toe game with a graphical interface, for two players.

Dictionary-Java.title: Search engine
Dictionary-Java.about: A small search engine: indexing a corpus, hash-based dictionaries, synonyms and word stemming, then ranking the most relevant documents for a query.

Client-Serveur-application.title: Book client / server
Client-Serveur-application.tagline: Querying a library over the network
Client-Serveur-application.about: A client and a server talking over TCP/IP: the client asks for a book by its reference, the server returns title, author, genre and length, and the connection stays open for the whole request.

Health-Traveler.tagline: A nursing practice modelled in XML
Health-Traveler.about: A web application for a nursing practice: patients, visits and invoices are described in XML, validated by schemas and turned into HTML pages with XSLT.

Todolist-Angular.title: Todo list
Todolist-Angular.about: A task list with add, edit, delete and filters, built as a MIAGE bachelor's lab.

Docker-Generator.tagline: A GitHub Action that builds a podcast feed
Docker-Generator.about: A GitHub Action running in a Docker container: it reads a YAML file describing the episodes and generates the podcast's RSS feed, then published on GitHub Pages.

Podcast-Generator.about: The podcast “The Future in Tech” published with the Docker Generator action: every change to the YAML file regenerates the RSS feed.

ecoconception-realworld-miage.title: Eco-design (backwards)
ecoconception-realworld-miage.tagline: Making an app as wasteful as possible, to learn
ecoconception-realworld-miage.about: MIAGE master's lab in pairs: take an Angular application and do the exact opposite of every eco-design best practice, with Lighthouse measurements to prove it.

measuring-energy-alumet.title: Measuring energy
measuring-energy-alumet.tagline: How much power does a program use?
measuring-energy-alumet.about: Master's lab sessions on measuring the energy consumption of computing workloads with the ALUMET tool, and analysing the results.

Code-stats.about: A copy of Tokei, a command-line tool that counts lines of code, comments and blank lines in a project, per language.
